methodology: Verse-by-verse preliminary reading of Qur'an 7:31–35 (Sahih International via legacy.quran.com) with selected English primary-text translations of Deuteronomy 14 and Jeremiah 7. Comparison locators are not public verified relationships; no Hebrew/Greek/Syriac critical collation, manuscript witness analysis, or inference of direct borrowing.

source_texts.title: Jeremiah 7:1–11
source_texts.translation: English rendering; verify against critical Hebrew text

records.summary: Adorn oneself at worship; eat and drink without excess

candidates.difference: Deuteronomy prescribes tithes and a meal before God at a chosen sanctuary; Qur'an 7:31 addresses adornment and general moderation without a tithe rule.

questions: Assess temple worship attire in Jewish/Christian late-antique traditions; avoid equating sanctuary meals with mosque worship.

records.summary: Who forbids adornment and good provisions; eschatological distinction

candidates.difference: Deuteronomy distinguishes clean and unclean animals; Qur'an challenges unauthorized blanket prohibition of good provisions, without repealing all food law.

questions: Investigate particular late antique ascetic or ritual restrictions only with traceable texts.

records.summary: Prohibitions on immorality, oppression, association of partners, and speaking without knowledge

candidates.difference: Jeremiah addresses Judah's temple confidence and social injustice, whereas Qur'an 7:33 gives a broad catalogue of prohibited acts.

questions: Test whether this is only a widespread prophetic ethical motif.

records.summary: Each community has an appointed term
questions: Seek a distinctive earlier text before proposing a parallel; do not treat common mortality language as evidence.

records.summary: Messengers among descendants of Adam, heed revelation, reform, and fear not

candidates.difference: Jeremiah's oracle addresses the temple community and continued dwelling in the land; Qur'an 7:35 gives a universal message to Adam's descendants and freedom from fear.

questions: Compare covenantal prophetic calls in Hebrew Bible and Syriac homiletics before publication.
